page.layout: One engraved plate filling the page: a frontispiece showing angels and a cross. The title is lettered on the cross-bar. The engraver's signature sits in the lower right corner. A blue library stamp at lower left is not transcribed.
page.notes: Copperplate frontispiece, not a printed title page. Angels hold a large cross diagonally across the plate, with a cherub at its foot. The banner on the cross-bar reads LIPSIUS DE CRUCE; the first letter is partly cut off at the left edge, so the L is only partly visible. Engraver's signature in the lower right: "A. Bloeling Sculps." The blue circular stamp at lower left and the faint marks at the lower right edge are library marks and are left out. Red stains at the left edge are not printed text.
